Claim 12 (Currently amended): A welding wire and container assembly, comprising: a housing consisting essentially of a recyclable material, the housing comprising: a cylindrical wall having a first end and a second end, wherein the cylindrical wall comprises a plurality of triangular portions folded radially inward at the second end; a support structure coupled to the plurality of triangular portions to provide a layered end assembly; and a coil of welding wire disposed in the housing and supported by the support structure at the base of the housing.

Claim 16 (Currently amended): The assembly of claim 12, wherein the triangular portions generally meet at an imaginary central axis of the cylindrical wall.
